title: Three variations of the approved GB Fixit homepage…
brief: Three variations of the approved GB Fixit homepage (.open-design/saas-landing/saas-landing.html). Keep the same style exactly: navy hero band, Barlow Semi Condensed uppercase headings, yellow buttons, pale-blue and mid-blue bands, Inside/Outside service cards with a smaller Rentals strip, photo slots, cartoon video, recent work, Meet Kris and Gary, deep navy closing. Vary the hero and the order/emphasis of sections only. Same copy and SEO.

### A · Photo-led  `(id: a-photo-led)`

Full-width hero photo of Kris and Gary behind a navy overlay with the headline and buttons on top; trust figures as a white bar overlapping the bottom of the hero; services straight after; video later in the page.

### B · Video-first  `(id: b-video-first)`

### C · Quote-first  `(id: c-quote-first)`

Hero with headline on the left and a compact free-quote form in a white card on the right (name, phone, job type, button); a strip of three project photos under the hero; services, then reviews, then video and Meet Kris and Gary.
